name: Laurent Bladekeeper
description: Play: Grant an ally +2|+2.
descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally +2|+2.
flavorText: "Yes, they are beautiful. But like any fine instrument, they only reveal their true beauty in the hands of a master."

name: Radiant Strike
description: Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
flavorText: "Undead fight like they've got no tomorrow. We'll make sure they won't get one." - Lucian

name: Brightsteel Protector
description: Play: Give an ally Barrier this round.
descriptionRaw: Play: Give an ally Barrier this round.
flavorText: "We are a prosperous nation because each warrior's fate is a coin we will never be content to spend." - code=04DE010

name: Decisive Action
description: Draw 2.
descriptionRaw: Draw 2.
flavorText: "A good duelist reacts to their opponent's moves. A *great* duelist has considered every move before it happens. Stand down, you are already beaten."

name: Lucian
levelupDescription: I've seen 4+ allied units or code=00DE007 die.
levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen 4+ allied units or code=00DE007 die.
flavorText: "World's full of monsters. If you're lucky, they're the ones you can see. The worst are the ones that stay under your skin."

name: Lucian
description: The first time an ally dies each round, if I see it, rally.
descriptionRaw: The first time an ally dies each round, if I see it, rally.
flavorText: "World's full of monsters. If you're lucky, they're the ones you can see. The worst are the ones that stay under your skin."

name: Garen
flavorText: "You think me rigid. Single-minded. Predictable. I am rigid, for nothing can sway me. I am single-minded, for I believe in Demacia. And I am predictable, for I will surely defeat you."

name: Garen
flavorText: "You think me rigid. Single-minded. Predictable. I am rigid, for nothing can sway me. I am single-minded, for I believe in Demacia. And I am predictable, for I will surely defeat you."

name: Senna, Sentinel of Light
description: The first time an allied code=00DE005 dies, grant me +1|+1 and Double Attack.
descriptionRaw: The first time an allied code=00DE005 dies, grant me +1|+1 and Double Attack.
flavorText: "Our Sentinels are the first line of defense between the tide of restless undead and the realms of man. We hit first, hit hard, and NEVER back down when the lives of our companions are on the line."

name: Prismatic Barrier
description: Give an ally Barrier this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally Barrier this round.
flavorText: "The world can turn its back on you when you're different. People say your differences make you weak--but they make us strong, compassionate. Even in the darkest times, I'll protect you!" - Lux

name: Lux
levelupDescription: I've seen you cast 6+ mana of spells in a round.
levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you cast 6+ mana of spells in a round.
flavorText: "I've always known there's something different about me... a light from within. I'm not sure what it is, but I have to find out!"

name: Final Spark
description: Deal 6 to an enemy unit.
descriptionRaw: Deal 6 to an enemy unit.
flavorText: "I've hidden my light for my whole life. What would happen if they knew... if *I* knew what I could really do?" - code=00DE009

name: Lux
description: Attack: Create a code=00DE009T1.
descriptionRaw: Attack: Create a code=00DE009T1.
flavorText: "I've always known there's something different about me... a light from within. I'm not sure what it is, but I have to find out!"

name: Cithria of Cloudfield
flavorText: "Each night before bed, my mother would tell me stories of Demacia's greatest heroes as she sharpened her sword. My dreams were full of adventures, and today I'll begin a story all my own."

name: Frost Shield
description: Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
flavorText: A canny warrior knows how to use the landscape to their advantage.

name: Avarosan Hearthguard
description: When I'm summoned, grant all allies in your deck +1|+1.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant all allies in your deck +1|+1.
flavorText: "Many tribes under one banner! Perhaps one day all the Freljord will fight side by side."

name: Frostbound Yeti
description: When I'm summoned, Frostbite enemies with 3 or less Health.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, Frostbite enemies with 3 or less Health.
flavorText: "AaaaaaaAAaaaAaaaaah!" - Bjerg the Wanderer

name: Avalanche
description: Deal 2 to EVERYTHING.
descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to EVERYTHING.
flavorText: The soul of every avalanche is a pebble that would not stay put.

name: Wyrding Stones
description: Start of Round: Get an extra mana gem this round.
descriptionRaw: Start of Round: Get an extra mana gem this round.
flavorText: "These ancient cairns are reminders that we are but the latest in a long line of tribes to brave these untamed lands." - Ashe

name: Alpha Wildclaw
flavorText: The power of a warhorse, the thoughtless savagery of a cat.

name: Battle Fury
description: Grant an ally +8|+1.
descriptionRaw: Grant an ally +8|+1.
flavorText: "I've been told I have a... temper." - Tryndamere

name: Ancient Yeti
description: End of Round: Reduce my cost by 1.
descriptionRaw: End of Round: Reduce my cost by 1.
flavorText: "What was that? Sounded like a sneeze. Do glaciers... sneeze?" - Bjerg the Wanderer

name: Mighty Poro
flavorText: "Ol' Longhorn here lost an eye defending the Poro King himself from an ornery wildclaw! After all, it's not the size of the hammer but the size of the heart that matters." - code=01FR025

name: Bloodsworn Pledge
description: Grant two allied units +0|+3.
descriptionRaw: Grant two allied units +0|+3.
flavorText: "I will be a torch in your heart, a shield at your side. Let me find strength to protect us and our kin, and may our lives flow together as the blood that seals this oath." - Tryndamere

name: Catalyst of Aeons
description: Get a mana gem and heal your Nexus 3.
descriptionRaw: Get a mana gem and heal your Nexus 3.
flavorText: "There has never been a winter that spring could not follow." - Avarosan expression

name: Ashe
description: Attack: Frostbite ALL the highest Power enemies.
descriptionRaw: Attack: Frostbite ALL the highest Power enemies.
levelupDescription: When you Frostbite 4+ enemies. Then create a code=00FR014T1 next round.
levelupDescriptionRaw: When you Frostbite 4+ enemies. Then create a code=00FR014T1 next round.
flavorText: "You are not our enemy. Our true foe is a long, lawless winter. We are all people of the Freljord, and this land belongs to all of us!"

name: Crystal Arrow
description:
Frostbite an enemy, then Frostbite enemies with 3 or less Health.
Draw 1.
descriptionRaw:
Frostbite an enemy, then Frostbite enemies with 3 or less Health.
Draw 1.
flavorText: "All the world on one arrow." - Ashe

name: Ashe's Flash Freeze
description:
Frostbite an enemy.
Create an code=00FR014 in your deck.
descriptionRaw:
Frostbite an enemy.
Create an code=00FR014 in your deck.
flavorText: The cold strikes without warning, rendering even the strongest warrior helpless.

name: Ashe
description:
Attack: Frostbite the highest Power enemies.
Aura: Enemies with 0 Power can't block.
descriptionRaw:
Attack: Frostbite the highest Power enemies.
Aura: Enemies with 0 Power can't block.
flavorText: "You are not our enemy. Our true foe is the long, lawless winter. We are all people of the Freljord, and this land belongs to all of us!"

name: Kindly Tavernkeeper
description: Play: Heal an ally 3.
descriptionRaw: Play: Heal an ally 3.
flavorText: "This fine old establishment's the Tipsy Owl! We've got stews and brews a'plenty to chase away the chill. Hurry on inside!"

name: Troop of Elnuks
description: Play: Summon each Elnuk in the top 10 cards of our deck.
descriptionRaw: Play: Summon each Elnuk in the top 10 cards of our deck.
flavorText: "Avarosans are like elnuks--dull-eyed grass-eaters easily felled by the unscarred. It is by numbers alone that they stay alive." - Vrynna, Scarmother

name: Tryndamere
levelupDescription: If I would die, instead I level up.
levelupDescriptionRaw: If I would die, instead I level up.
flavorText: "Do not die for your cause. Live for it"

name: Tryndamere
flavorText: "Do not die for your cause. Live for it"

name: Tryndamere's Battle Fury
description:
Grant an ally +8|+4.
Create a code=00FR017 in your deck.
descriptionRaw:
Grant an ally +8|+4.
Create a code=00FR017 in your deck.
flavorText: "I've been told I have a... temper." - Tryndamere

name: Braum
flavorText:
"Papa, tell the one about Braum and his door!"
"Or when his fall split a mountain in two!"
"Oh! Whattabout when he saved the tavern from the rampaging yeti?!"

name: Braum
flavorText:
"Papa, tell the one about code=01FR009 and his door!"
"Or when his fall split a mountain in two!"
"Oh! Whattabout when he saved the tavern from the rampaging yeti?!"

name: Bull Elnuk
flavorText: Avarosan folk tales speak of "Old Uncle Elnuk", a stubborn old grouch who wanted nothing more than a warm patch of grass and an argument to dig his heel into.

name: Stalking Wolf
description: When I'm summoned, the enemy summons a code=00FR020T1.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, the enemy summons a code=00FR020T1.
flavorText: "You cannot make a wolf from a hare." - Winter's Claw proverb

name: Snow Hare
flavorText: "Wolf or hare, winter makes prey of us all." - Avarosan proverb

name: Shadow Fiend
flavorText: "What would you sacrifice for power? Your path begins with an oath, and ends only when it has taken all you have to give." - Zed

name: Navori Highwayman
description: When I'm summoned, summon a code=00IO002T1 with my icononly=trueicononly=truestats.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a code=00IO002T1 with my icononly=trueicononly=truestats.
flavorText: "I was a traveling musician, known in every village 'ere to the Placidium--until the Noxus came. Now I'm scraping by on stolen coin. Mother was right, should've been a healer... "

name: Navori Brigand
flavorText: A bandit on the road means more in the brush.

name: Shadowshift
description: Swap two allied units.
descriptionRaw: Swap two allied units.
flavorText: They strike at shades and whispers, while I tear out their hearts. - Zed

name: Ritual of Renewal
description: Heal anything 7. Draw 1.
descriptionRaw: Heal anything 7. Draw 1.
flavorText: "Only when the mind is elevated can the body be made whole." - Karma

name: Greenglade Lookout
description: Strike: Reduce the cost of the most expensive unit in your hand by 1.
descriptionRaw: Strike: Reduce the cost of the most expensive unit in your hand by 1.
flavorText: "Patrol, we've one... no... TWO massive furry creatures coming our way! Call for ba--Oh. Hold on. Scope's wrong way 'round again..."

name: Yasuo
description: When you Stun or Recall an enemy, I deal 2 to it.
descriptionRaw: When you Stun or Recall an enemy, I deal 2 to it.
flavorText: "Death is like the wind... always by my side."

name: Yasuo's Steel Tempest
description:
Stun an attacking enemy.
Shuffle a Yasuo into your deck.
descriptionRaw:
Stun an attacking enemy.
Shuffle a Yasuo into your deck.
flavorText: "A decisive strike need not be a lethal one." - Yasuo

name: Yasuo
description: When you Stun or Recall an enemy, I strike it.
descriptionRaw: When you Stun or Recall an enemy, I strike it.
flavorText: "Death is like the wind... always by my side."

name: Fae Bladetwirler
description: When you Stun or Recall a unit, grant me +2|+0.
descriptionRaw: When you Stun or Recall a unit, grant me +2|+0.
flavorText: "Oh, so you think I'm 'cute'? 'Fuzzy'?? Let's see how 'adorable' you find THIS!"

name: The Empyrean
flavorText: "The sky itself heaved as coils of clouds and powerful winds flattened our brigade. We tried to follow it, but who can chase the wind?" - code=01NX010

name: Nimble Poro
flavorText: "This might sound crazy, but the last thing I remember was a... fuzzy sensation...?" - code=01IO052T1

name: Steel Tempest
description: Stun an attacking enemy.
descriptionRaw: Stun an attacking enemy.
flavorText: "A decisive strike need not be a lethal one." - Yasuo

name: Zed
description: Attack: Create an attacking code=00IO011T1 with my stats.
descriptionRaw: Attack: Create an attacking code=00IO011T1 with my stats.
levelupDescription: My shadows and I have struck the enemy Nexus twice.
levelupDescriptionRaw: My shadows and I have struck the enemy Nexus twice.
flavorText: "Balance is a fool's master. The shadows have shown me true power."

name: Zed
description: Attack: Create an attacking code=00IO011T1 with my stats, transferable keywords, and additional text.
descriptionRaw: Attack: Create an attacking code=00IO011T1 with my stats, transferable keywords, and additional text.
flavorText: "Fools cling to the lie of balance. There is only perfection or death."

name: Living Shadow
flavorText: The shadow's blade is just as real as the man's - a fact most learned only as it sliced their throats.

name: Twin Disciplines
description: Give an ally +3|+0 or +0|+3 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +3|+0 or +0|+3 this round.
flavorText: "Never fear change. It will question you, test your limits. It is our greatest teacher." - Karma

name: Discipline of Force
description: Give an ally +3|+0 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +3|+0 this round.
flavorText: "Never fear change. It will question you, test your limits. It is our greatest teacher." - Karma

name: Discipline of Fortitude
description: Give an ally +0|+3 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +0|+3 this round.
flavorText: "Never fear change. It will question you, test your limits. It is our greatest teacher." - Karma

name: Keeper of Masks
description: When I'm summoned, give other allied units +1|+0 this round.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, give other allied units +1|+0 this round.
flavorText: "On this day, yours will become the face of discipline, training, humility, and balance. Today, you become Kinkou."

name: Yone, Windchaser
description: noimg=true: Pick 2 enemy units. Play code=00IO014T1 on them.
descriptionRaw: noimg=true: Pick 2 enemy units. Play code=00IO014T1 on them.
flavorText: "When I was a child, I asked my brother: 'Does the wind flee, or does it follow?' He followed me then for guidance. I follow him now for justice."

name: Staggering Strikes
description: Stun 2 enemies.
descriptionRaw: Stun 2 enemies.
flavorText: "Stand aside. I have come for the Unforgiven." - Yone, Windchaser

name: Minah Swiftfoot
description: noimg=true: Pick 3 enemies. Play code=00IO015T1 on them.
descriptionRaw: noimg=true: Pick 3 enemies. Play code=00IO015T1 on them.
flavorText: "There we were, tearing across the meadow and suddenly, this KID just leaps out from nowhere and BAM, BAM, BAM--knocks the wind right outta us!" - code=01IO052T1

name: Skyward Strikes
description: Recall 3 enemies.
descriptionRaw: Recall 3 enemies.
flavorText: "We go FLYING and next thing I know I'm flat on my back!" - code=01IO052T1

name: Will of Ionia
description: Recall a unit.
descriptionRaw: Recall a unit.
flavorText: When invaders first set foot on Ionian soil, they found that conquering the land's inhabitants alone would not be enough.

name: Scaled Snapper
description: Play: I'm have 5|2 or 2|5.
descriptionRaw: Play: I'm have 5|2 or 2|5.
flavorText: One of the oldest inhabitants of the Greenglade, it has withstood the test of time through constant adaptation.

name: Scaled Snapper
flavorText: One of the oldest inhabitants of the Greenglade, it has withstood the test of time through constant adaptation.

name: Scaled Snapper
flavorText: One of the oldest inhabitants of the Greenglade, it has withstood the test of time through constant adaptation.

name: Sparring Student
description: When you play or summon a unit, give me +1|+1 this round.
descriptionRaw: When you play or summon a unit, give me +1|+1 this round.
flavorText: "What's the point of fighting if there's no one to see your moves?"

name: Prolong
description: Pick a Fleeting card in hand, remove Fleeting from it.
descriptionRaw: Pick a Fleeting card in hand, remove Fleeting from it.

name: Invent!
description: Pick a card from 3 random cards to create in and and reduce its cost by 1.
descriptionRaw: Pick a card from 3 random cards to create in and and reduce its cost by 1.
flavorText: "Atoms aren't the only fellows who get to make up everything! Now you can, too!" - Heimerdinger

name: Darius
flavorText: "An iron will and a titan's strength. There is no finer general to lead the Trifarian Legion." - Jericho Swain

name: Draven
flavorText: "You want an autograph? Get in line, pal."

name: Arena Battlecaster
description: Attack: Give other battling allied units +1|+0 this round.
descriptionRaw: Attack: Give other battling allied units +1|+0 this round.
flavorText: He roared with glee. For a moment, the heart of the arena pulsed in time with his and the excitement of the assembled masses was clutched in his triumphant hand.

name: Affectionate Poro
flavorText: "Noxus has no room for... for weakn--Will someone get this DAMNED THING OFF ME?!" - Darius

name: Legion Rearguard
flavorText: In Noxus, where soldiers are revered for their audacity on the battlefield, rearguard duty is nothing short of a punishment.

name: Arachnoid Host
description: When I'm summoned, grant other allied Spider units +2|+0.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant other allied Spider units +2|+0.
flavorText: A single glance and you're hers. A single bite and you're theirs.

name: Augmented Experimenter
description: noimg=true: Pick a target. Play code=00PZ001T1 on it.
descriptionRaw: noimg=true: Pick a target. Play code=00PZ001T1 on it.
flavorText: His dreams cost him his hands, yet he persisted. Nothing would stand in his way.

name: Reckless Research
description: Discard your hand. Deal 3 to anything and draw 3.
descriptionRaw: Discard your hand. Deal 3 to anything and draw 3.
flavorText: Progress, whatever the price.

name: Piltovan Powerup
description: Give an ally +2|+2 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+2 this round.
flavorText:
"Ready? Say... augmentation!"
"EeeeEEEP!"
"Close enough!"

name: Crackling Platbot
flavorText: Bzzzzt!

name: Funsmith
description: Aura: All of your spells and skills deal 1 extra damage.
descriptionRaw: Aura: All of your spells and skills deal 1 extra damage.
flavorText: "You want extra boom, do ya? Well, you've come to the right place!"

name: Ezreal
description: Nexus Strike: Create a code=00PZ005T1. Discard it end of round.
descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Create a code=00PZ005T1. Discard it end of round.
flavorText: "Impossible is my favorite kind of possible!"

name: Mystic Shot
description: Deal 2 to anything.
descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to anything.
flavorText: "I. Never. Miss. But I have been known to fire a warning shot or two..." - Ezreal

name: Ezreal
description:
Nexus Strike: Create a Fleeting 0 cost code=00PZ005T1.
After you cast a spell: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
descriptionRaw:
Nexus Strike: Create a Fleeting 0 cost code=00PZ005T1.
After you cast a spell: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
flavorText: "Impossible is my favorite kind of possible!"

name: Trueshot Barrage
description: Deal 2 to three enemies.
descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to three enemies.
flavorText: "When you've got talent, there's no such thing as a lucky shot." - Ezreal

name: Rummage
description:
To play, discard 2.
Draw 2
descriptionRaw:
To play, discard 2.
Draw 2
flavorText: "It only looks like chaos because my organizational matrices are far more complex than you can comprehend! ...now where did I put that wrench?" - Heimerdinger

name: Progress Day!
description: Draw 3 then reduce their cost by 1.
descriptionRaw: Draw 3 then reduce their cost by 1.
flavorText:
PROGRESS DAY!
Celebrate at the PLAZA OF THE SUN GATES!
See HEXTECH WONDERS!
Gasp at the DARING PORO!
Hear the MAN OF TOMORROW speak on the STATE OF TODAY!
FREE entry!
Piltovan children welcome!

name: Heimerdinger
description: When I'm summoned, summon two Wrechbots.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon two Wrechbots.
flavorText: "Mad scientist? Pft! I'm clearly a very-stable-if-slightly-disorganized-and-eclectic scientist, thank you very much!"

name: Wrenchbot
flavorText: "To innovate, I must have the right tools. To have the best tools, I must innovate!" - Heimerdinger's notes

name: Heimerdinger
description: When I'm summoned, summon a Giga-Squisher 900.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Giga-Squisher 900.
flavorText: "Mad scientist? Pft! I'm clearly a very-stable-if-slightly-disorganized-and-eclectic scientist, thank you very much!"

name: Astute Academic
description: Draw 1
descriptionRaw: Draw 1
flavorText: Imagination is the spark of great invention. Yet, it is research that makes the spark a conflagration.

name: Jinx
flavorText: "It's all just fun and games until something gets blown up - then it's a PARTY!"

name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
description: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to the rest.
descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to the rest.
flavorText: "See ya!" - Jinx

name: Jinx
description: The first time you empty your hand each round, create a code=00PZ012T1 in hand.
descriptionRaw: The first time you empty your hand each round, create a code=00PZ012T1 in hand.
flavorText: "It's all just fun and games until something gets blown up - then it's a PARTY!"

name: Amped Up
description: Grant a unit +3|+3.
descriptionRaw: Grant a unit +3|+3.
flavorText: "YEAH! YEAH! YEAHYEAHYEAH!" - Jinx

name: Forked Lightning
description:
Deal 1 to 2 enemies.
Draw 1.
descriptionRaw:
Deal 1 to 2 enemies.
Draw 1.
flavorText: "All progress has a price! A few scorched hairs or zapped fingers if you're lucky... and uh... um. Where was I?" - Dillapus Moroe, Scientist

name: T-Hex
flavorText: Some say Heimerdinger had created something even greater than his most powerful turret - a piece of hextech so titanic in size and scope as to dwarf all things that came before. Even among yordles, most dismissed it as legend.

name: Porobot
flavorText: It's not quite as cuddly as the real thing, but it IS just as cute.

name: Rising Spell Force
description: Give an ally +4|+0 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +4|+0 this round.
flavorText: Whereas most hextech weapons lost potency and charge with use, Ezreal's gauntlet increased in power and speed with each successive blast.

name: Chempunk Shredder
description: noimg=true: Play code=00PZ018T1
descriptionRaw: noimg=true: Play code=00PZ018T1
flavorText: "Huge crowds packed into a small space with a chem-powered instrument that spouts enormous spurts of flame. What could go wrong?"

name: Face-Melter
description: Deal 1 to all enemy Units.
descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all enemy Units.
flavorText: "Let the show begin!" - code=00PZ018

name: Plaza Guardian
description: Reduce my cost by 1 for each spell you've cast this game.
descriptionRaw: Reduce my cost by 1 for each spell you've cast this game.
flavorText: You have twenty seconds to comply.

name: Thresh
flavorText:
Cling clang, go the chains, someone's out to find you,
Cling clang, oh the chains, the Warden's right behind you...

name: House Spider
flavorText: "My spiders love company. Shame that company never feels the same." - Elise

name: Elise
description: Attack: Summon an attacking code=01SI002.
descriptionRaw: Attack: Summon an attacking code=01SI002.
levelupDescription: Start of Round: You have 3+ other Spiders.
levelupDescriptionRaw: Start of Round: You have 3+ other Spiders.
flavorText: Once the head of a powerful Noxian house, Elise's dark ties to the Shadow Isles granted her unnatural youth and beauty in exchange for a few unwitting souls offered in sacrifice. An easy decision.

name: Spiderling
flavorText: "What are you afraid of? It's just ONE little spider." - Lord Sassen, Hapless Aristocrat

name: Spider Queen Elise
flavorText: Once the head of a powerful Noxian house, Elise's dark ties to the Shadow Isles granted her unnatural youth and beauty in exchange for a few unwitting souls offered in sacrifice. An easy decision.

name: Cursed Keeper
description: Last Breath: Summon an code=00SI005T1.
descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Summon an code=00SI005T1.
flavorText: Madness and time. Never was there a more terrible pair.

name: Escaped Abomination
flavorText: Time may have stopped, but madness remains.

name: Bandle Balance
description: Exchange an ally follower for an enemy follower.
descriptionRaw: Exchange an ally follower for an enemy follower.
flavorText:
"For... Demacia?"
"Oh, shoot. Does Noxus have a battlecry? 'For strength'? Ugh, please switch me back!"

name: Hooked Help
description: An ally Captures an enemy.
descriptionRaw: An ally Captures an enemy.
flavorText: "Count yer blessins we found ye 'fore them snapjaws, laddie. As fer yer payment, cap's found yer purse wantin', so ye'll be paying off yer salvation wi' hard labor. Eagle's nest needs mannin', if ye've the stomach fer heights, else ye'll be tendin' the deck. Third option's the snapjaws, 'course..." - code=02BW008

name: Dust Up Diplomacy
description: Draw 1, deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus, and summon a random 1 cost follower.
descriptionRaw: Draw 1, deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus, and summon a random 1 cost follower.
flavorText: What happens in a Bilgewater bar brawl? Everything, clearly.

name: Drowned Marauder
description: Play: Play code=99BW004T1.
descriptionRaw: Play: Play code=99BW004T1.

name: Mutiny
description: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.

name: Healing Balm
description: Heal an ally 5.
descriptionRaw: Heal an ally 5.
flavorText:
"I woke in an infirmary, with a young nurse tending to my wounds. The concoction smelled foul, but I cannot deny its efficacy..."
- Notes from Cithria's diary

name: Demacian Merchant
description: When I'm summoned, create an Unyielding Spirit in hand.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create an Unyielding Spirit in hand.
flavorText: "Some provisions for your long journey?"

name: Poro Party!
description: Summon three different, random 1 cost Poros. Grant Poro allies +2|+2.
descriptionRaw: Summon three different, random 1 cost Poros. Grant Poro allies +2|+2.
flavorText:
"MOM DA POROS ARE COMING FOR DINNA!"
"Okay, Ingvar."
"AND DEY'RE BRINGIN' FRIENDS!"
"Okay, Ingvar."

name: Poro Nip
description: Allied Poros strike an enemy.
descriptionRaw: Allied Poros strike an enemy.

name: Recursion
description: Copy the next spell you play this round onto the same targets.
descriptionRaw: Copy the next spell you play this round onto the same targets.
flavorText: "Our world is made of patterns. The petals of a flower. The scales on a snapper. So too, does magic ebb and flow along its common path." - Ionian master

name: Bottled Constellation
description: Refill your mana and spell mana.
descriptionRaw: Refill your mana and spell mana.
flavorText: As it happens, the universe has notes of toast, cinnamon, fennel, and angst.

descriptionRaw: Pick one of three effects. Can't be cast in combat or in response to a spell.

descriptionRaw: Summon a code=99NU001T3 and heal your Nexus 4.

descriptionRaw: Rally. Give all allies +3|+3 and Overwhelm this round.

descriptionRaw:
Aura: I cannot be Silenced or Recalled.

descriptionRaw: Pick one of three effects. Can't be cast in combat or in response to a spell.
flavorText: They look like big, good, strong hands, don't they?

name: Krug
flavorText: Best to keep it at a distance!

descriptionRaw: Get two empty mana gems and draw two cards.

descriptionRaw: Summon a code=99NU004T2 and heal your Nexus 3.

descriptionRaw: A non-Jungle ally and a Jungle enemy strike each other.

name: Jailed Champion
description: Round Start: If your opponent doesn't have a Guard, kill me. When I leave play, revive your champion.
descriptionRaw: Round Start: If your opponent doesn't have a Guard, kill me. When I leave play, revive your champion.
flavorText: You can't imprison me! I'm a CHAMPION!

name: Jailer
description: When I'm summoned, set my health to the opponent's champion's cost.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, set my health to the opponent's champion's cost.
flavorText: Where'd I leave those keys?

name: Duplicator
description: Pick 1 of 4 cards in your Regions. Create a copy in hand and shuffle 2 copies into your deck.
descriptionRaw: Pick 1 of 4 cards in your Regions. Create a copy in hand and shuffle 2 copies into your deck.

name: Double-Edged
description: Give an ally +2|+2 this round.
descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+2 this round.
flavorText: "I use this side to shave with the grain and the other to go against it for that smooth-as-a-baby's-backside finish." - Draven

name: Got Axes?
description: Create 4 Whirling Deaths in your deck. Whirling Deaths everywhere cost 1 less. Draw 1.
descriptionRaw: Create 4 Whirling Deaths in your deck. Whirling Deaths everywhere cost 1 less. Draw 1.
flavorText: "I'm up to my 'stache in axes here!" - Draven

name: League of Draven
description: If Draven isn't in play, summon him. Draven strikes all enemies.
descriptionRaw: If Draven isn't in play, summon him. Draven strikes all enemies.
flavorText: "Welcoooome to Draaaaaaven's rift." - Draven

name: Warband Recruit
description: Summon a random Noxian Soldier.
descriptionRaw: Summon a random Noxian Soldier.
flavorText: "If one dies, take their place. The few for the many." - Swain

name: Tactical Prowess
description:
Stun all enemies.
Rally.
descriptionRaw:
Stun all enemies.
Rally.
flavorText: "If one dies, take their place. The few for the many." - Swain

name: Strength Above All
description: Your strongest ally strikes the enemy Nexus.
descriptionRaw: Your strongest ally strikes the enemy Nexus.
flavorText: "Hit 'em hard! Hit 'em fast!" - Darius

name: The Hand of Noxus
description: Raise all allies' Power to the highest Power among allies. Grant all allies Overwhelm.
descriptionRaw: Raise all allies' Power to the highest Power among allies. Grant all allies Overwhelm.
flavorText: "The Hand of Noxus will form a mighty fist and crush all who dare oppose us." - Boram Darkwill

name: Artillery Fire
description: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus 3 times.
descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus 3 times.
flavorText: "We will show that none are beyond the empire's reach! Fire!" - Noxian Artillery Commander

name: Treacherous Flock
description: Create 4 Ravenous Flocks in your deck. Ravenous Flocks everywhere deal 2 more damage. Draw 1.
descriptionRaw: Create 4 Ravenous Flocks in your deck. Ravenous Flocks everywhere deal 2 more damage. Draw 1.
flavorText: "Birds of a treasonous feather flock together." - Scribbled on a crumpled propaganda flyer

name: Carve a Path
description: Create 4 Decimates in your deck. Decimates everywhere cost 2 less. Draw 1.
descriptionRaw: Create 4 Decimates in your deck. Decimates everywhere cost 2 less. Draw 1.
flavorText: "Never go around if you can cut straight through." - Noxian military mantra

name: Ever Onward
description: Summon a random 6+ cost follower. It can't block.
descriptionRaw: Summon a random 6+ cost follower. It can't block.
flavorText: "Out of my way!" - code=01NX051

name: Let Loose
description: Deal 2 to a follower.
descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a follower.
flavorText: The ballista bolts were initially designed to splinter gates and shatter portcullises. But during the Siege of Caulcastle, as the staving rebels poured from their defenses, the Noxians found the bolts brutally effective against infantry, too.

name: Noxian Merchant
description: When I'm summoned, grant allies Overwhelm.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant allies Overwhelm.
flavorText: "Steel! Steel to make Noxians strong."

name: Double Agent
description: Strike: ALL players draw 1.
descriptionRaw: Strike: ALL players draw 1.
flavorText: Wardens are paid well for their loyalty. Chembarons pay even better. Smart folk can have both, long as they don't get caught.

name: Tinskull Boss
flavorText:
"Name: Ishaea Tinthrum
Age: Presumed 20-25
 Location: Lower Docks, Warehouse C-86.
Notes: Leader of a new gang known as the 'Tinskullz'. Taken up residence in the above location. Warehouse previously condemned for unsafe conditions.
Recommended Action: Apprehend at the earliest opportunity."
- Piltover enforcer file, part 1

name: Klaxon Lawbot
description: When I'm summoned, create a code=99PZ103T1 in hand.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a code=99PZ103T1 in hand.
flavorText:
"MR. BERZ. STOP. RIGHT. THERE!"
"Shut up, you little turnip! What are you gonna do if I don't, anyway? Get your big scary mates on me?"
"CORRECT."

name: Steeltoe Lawbot
flavorText:
"BACKUP. ARRIVED."
"Oh yeah, whatcha gonna do now? Throw your metal hand out at me an' stop me from fightin' yous?"
"ALSO CORRECT."

name: Rocketboarder
flavorText:
"Whaddya think, Fishbones?"
"I think it's going to be super fast, and super dangerous, and you should put it back before--"
"You LOVE it! Aw Fishbones you're the BEST!" - Jinx, and uh also Fishbones I guess?

name: Tinskull Burner
description: When I'm summoned, create 2 Ignitions in hand.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create 2 Ignitions in hand.
flavorText:
"Notes Contd: Fortunately, their ambition was soon curtailed by their engineering skill. The only location the Tinskullz successful attacked was their own."
- Piltover enforcer file, part 3

name: Charming Guildmember
description: Play: Create in hand a copy of an enemy follower.
descriptionRaw: Play: Create in hand a copy of an enemy follower.
flavorText:
"So, you'd like to be in the Explorer's Guild? Well, I'm not surprised, but let me tell you, it's no walk in the park. You'll need wits, courage, and--"
"Ugh. A balloon for all your hot air?"

name: Class Cutter
description: Play: Deal 1 to an enemy.
descriptionRaw: Play: Deal 1 to an enemy.
flavorText: Can't be late for class if you never show up in the first place.

name: Chirean Grayback
description: When I'm summoned, grant other allied Chirean Graybacks everywhere +2|+0.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant other allied Chirean Graybacks everywhere +2|+0.
flavorText: "Yeah, they might have a kinda creepy look to 'em--what with those goggles 'n all--but they're harmless enough. Just don't go threatenin' their dens without expecting them to reply in kind." - code=01PZ017

name: Proud Purveyor
description: Play: Manifest a spell from your regions.
descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a spell from your regions.
flavorText: "Welcome to Zalies' Bizarre Bazaar! We've got trinkets, we've got curios, we've got gadgets! The only thing we don't have? Refunds. All sales final, thank you!"

name: Creature Cataloguer
description: When you summon a unit with a subtype, grant it +1|+0.
descriptionRaw: When you summon a unit with a subtype, grant it +1|+0.
flavorText: "Fascinating! You can tell by the bulge along the gum ridge that this specimen had at least two more sets of teeth coming in. Given our current understanding of this genus, that puts the creature at around twenty-four weeks old. How did you say you defeated it, again?"

name: House Whump
description: When I'm summoned, plant 2 Flashbomb Traps randomly in the top 10 cards of the enemy deck.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, plant 2 Flashbomb Traps randomly in the top 10 cards of the enemy deck.
flavorText:
"CAT FOUND!!!
FEMALE. NOT VERY FRIENDLY. LIKES JEWELRY.
NOT HOUSE BROKEN EITHER :(.
IF SHE'S YOURS, PLEASE TAKE HER BACK."
- Flyer placed on Piltover noticeboard.

name: Hextech Observatory
description: Each round, the first time you cast a spell, refill mana equal to its cost.
descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you cast a spell, refill mana equal to its cost.
flavorText: Following its grand opening, the Hextech Observatory quickly became a popular spot for locals and visitors alike. Here they could mingle with some of the greatest minds alive, and see for themselves the very technology that promised to drive Piltover onward.

name: Eramis, Baron of Taste
description: When I'm summoned, create in hand 3 copies of 6+ cost spells from your deck.
descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create in hand 3 copies of 6+ cost spells from your deck.
flavorText:
"Heh, yeah boss, it's real pretty, heh."
"Gems are pretty, fool. This is ART. And for the last time, refer to me by my TITLE!"

name: Tinskull Tank
flavorText:
"Name: Tinskullz
Location: Lower Docks, Warehouse C-86.
Notes: The Tinskullz planned on employing an army of small mechs to do their work. According to analysis, the first wave of their assault was to be a handful of heavily-armored tanks breaking down enemy doors, before the combustion units burned their rivals out of business."
- Piltover enforcer file, part 2

name: Augmented Poro
flavorText:
"My experiments in bringing the glorious evolution to other species is... ongoing."
- Viktor's research notes

name: Tinskull Tinkerer
flavorText: The fire of ingenuity that burned so bright in his heart was matched only by the literal fire burning just a few feet away.

name: Arm of the Law
description: Deal 4 to a follower.
descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to a follower.
flavorText: "Well, that's just cheatin', that is." - Mr. Berz, Midenstokke Henchman

name: Mischief and Mayhem
description: Deal 1 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
flavorText:
"Hey, Detective Bert, wanna help me make a REAL big bang??"
"Sure thing, sport! Like the lady says, teamwork makes the SCREAMS work!"

name: The Loose Cannon
description: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. Reduce the cost of your cards EVERYWHERE by 2.
descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. Reduce the cost of your cards EVERYWHERE by 2.
flavorText: "Sure, we could sit here, come up with a plan, follow it or whatever. Orrrr BULLETS BULLETS BULLETS BULLETS BULLETS--" - Jinx

name: The Sheriff of Piltover
description: Plant a code=05PZ008 on each card in the enemy deck.
descriptionRaw: Plant a code=05PZ008 on each card in the enemy deck.
flavorText: Caitlyn is almost always three steps ahead of her quarry. When she's not, she has these.

name: Involuntary Testing
description: Create in hand 2 copies of a random 1 cost card from your deck.
descriptionRaw: Create in hand 2 copies of a random 1 cost card from your deck.
flavorText: "Soooooo turns out a couple little goobers snuck into the machine while I was cleaning the power switch, aaaaaand..." - code=04PZ012

name: The Defender of Tomorrow
description: Draw a 6+ cost spell from your deck and refill your mana.
descriptionRaw: Draw a 6+ cost spell from your deck and refill your mana.
flavorText: "Hextech can do anything. Anything. We're going to change the world." - Jayce

name: Jolt
description: Deal 1 to an enemy follower and 1 to the enemy Nexus.
descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to an enemy follower and 1 to the enemy Nexus.
flavorText:
"The innate power in these crystals is frankly hard to describe. My first task was to create safe overflow paths for the excess energy..."
- Excerpt from Jayce's journal

name: The Boy Who Shattered Time
description: For the rest of the game, when you Predict grant your allies +1|+0. Predict.
descriptionRaw: For the rest of the game, when you Predict grant your allies +1|+0. Predict.
flavorText: "When I have a great idea, I've gotta rewind twice. Once to get it right in my head, and once to savor the moment." - Ekko

name: Pow-Pow
description: Deal 3 to a unit.
descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to a unit.
flavorText: She names every bullet, too.

name: The Piltover Enforcer
description: Grant an allied champion +4|+4, then it strikes the strongest enemy.
descriptionRaw: Grant an allied champion +4|+4, then it strikes the strongest enemy.
flavorText: "Whoa! These things kinda almost punch themselves. That's gonna throw me off a little." - Vi

name: Captive Audience
description: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus or Stun an enemy.
descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus or Stun an enemy.

name: Captive Audience
description: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.

name: Captive Audience
description: Stun an enemy.
descriptionRaw: Stun an enemy.

description: Pick an allied follower. Pick 1 of 3 random followers that cost 2 more to transform it into.
